question: As per an estimate by the ‘Food Waste Index Report 2021’, released by the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) in March 2021, India wastes approximately ______ kg food per person per year.
solution:
The correct answer is** __50__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• As per an estimate by the** ‘Food Waste Index Report 2021’,** released by the **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)** in March 2021.

 
 
• **India wastes approximately 50 kg of food per person per year.**
 
• The household food waste estimate in the** US is 59 kg per capita per year,** or 19,359,951 tonnes a year.
 
• In **China, these estimates are 64 kg per capita** per year or 91,646,213 tonnes a year.
 
 
 
• The** United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and WRAP** released the Food Waste Index Report 2021.
 
• **According to this report, 931 million tonnes of food were wasted globally in 2019.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• UNEP Headquarters:** Nairobi, Kenya.**
 
• UNEP Head:** Inger Andersen.**
 
• UNEP Founder: **Maurice Strong.**
 
• UNEP Founded:** 5 June 1972, Nairobi, Kenya.**
